question: What has Raymond James said about its affiliation models, and has the mix shifted?

claims.text: On the call published October 2024 (period ended 2024-09-30), Paul Reilly said management remained focused on serving advisors across its multiple affiliation options. He also said a couple of OSJ relationships in the independent contractor division had decided to leave the platform. Roughly $3 billion of AUA left in the fiscal fourth quarter, and about $5 billion more was expected to transfer off in early fiscal 2025.
On the call published January 2025 (period ended 2024-12-31), Reilly again said the firm remained focused on serving advisors across its multiple affiliation options.
On the call published April 2025 (period ended 2025-03-31), Paul Shoukry said advisor recruiting pipelines were strong and building rapidly across the firm's affiliation options.
The June 2025 investor day deck lists "Multiple Affiliation Options" with "Advisor and Book Ownership" and "Stability" under the heading "Best of Both Worlds".

On the call published July 2025 (period ended 2025-06-30), Shoukry said the advisor recruiting pipeline was growing significantly across all affiliation options. He said activity had accelerated across all options, and that long-tenured teams had not seen such acceleration since the financial crisis.

On the same July 2025 call, Shoukry said the firm was seeing good success across all affiliation options. He added that "the acceleration rate within the independent channel is probably higher", while the employee option and the independent RIA option were also seeing very good success. This is management's qualitative description of relative momentum, not a reported mix figure.

The fiscal 2025 10-K (published 2025-11-25) says the firm offers multiple affiliation options, which it calls AdvisorChoice®. Financial advisors primarily affiliate directly as employees or independent contractors, or as employees of third-party RIAs and broker-dealers served through the RIA and Custody Services (RCS) division. The 10-K describes employee advisors as working in a traditional branch with local management and administrative staff.

On the call published January 2026 (period ended 2025-12-31), Shoukry said the firm has the largest addressable market across its affiliation options, "from employee to independent contractor to the RIA custody". He said it has critical mass and decades of experience in all of them, and that advisors are coming from wires, regionals and other independents.

The firm's recruiting page (page content as of 2026-04-21) lists five AdvisorChoice® options: Traditional Employee, Advisor Select, Independent Contractor, Bank & Credit Union, and Corporate RIA. A page with content as of 2026-03-11 describes Advisor Select® as an employee affiliation option in which advisors lead their own branch. A page with content as of 2026-05-19 describes the Corporate RIA affiliation model for fee-based advisors.
In the April 22, 2026 earnings release, Shoukry said financial advisor recruiting activity across all affiliation options remains robust.

On the call published July 2026 (period ended 2026-06-30), Shoukry said the recruiting pipeline is strong across the different affiliation options. He described "broad-based strength" and momentum "across our affiliation options". He gave an example of a team with $5 million of production that was weighing which affiliation option to choose.

WealthManagement.com trade press (published 2026-10-29, indicative only) reports that Shoukry said recruiting success is spread across all affiliation channels, including RIA custody. According to the article, he said the independent contractor channel is seeing the most interest in dollar volume. He also said the RIA custody division is growing at a high percentage rate on a smaller base. The article reports trailing 12-month production of $538 million, up from $407 million, for recruited advisors joining the domestic independent contractor and employee channels. It does not split this figure by channel.

adjacent.text: The trade-press items from August and September 2026 describe individual advisors joining Raymond James Financial Services (the independent channel) and Raymond James & Associates (the employee channel).
adjacent.differs_because: These are individual recruiting announcements. They are anecdotes and say nothing about the overall mix of advisors or assets across affiliation models.

gaps.what: A quantified mix of advisors, assets or production by affiliation model (employee, independent contractor, RCS/RIA custody, and others) over time is not in the evidence. Whether the mix has shifted can only be inferred from management's qualitative remarks, such as faster acceleration in the independent channel (July 2025 call) and the most dollar interest in independent contractors (trade press, October 2026). It is not shown by reported figures.
gaps.suggested_source: Raymond James 10-K and 10-Q segment and advisor-count tables, the quarterly financial supplement, and investor-day materials that break out advisors and assets by channel
